title: Maui County issues redesigned driver's licenses and state ID cards with enhanced security
text:
Maui County issues redesigned driver’s licenses and state ID cards with enhanced security
The County of Maui Department of Finance Division of Motor Vehicles and Licensing announced on July 29 that it is now issuing Hawai‘i’s newly redesigned driver’s licenses and state identification cards. The updated cards include advanced security features to help prevent identity theft, counterfeiting, and fraud while continuing to meet federal REAL ID requirements.
Residents who need a duplicate-reissue driver’s license or state ID card, but are not within six months of their card’s expiration date, are encouraged to use the County DMVL’s new online request form. This form is designed to streamline the replacement process for eligible applicants and improve customer service.
The online request form can be accessed at www.mauicounty.gov/dmvl. Applicants should complete the form, print it out, and either drop it off or mail it to the County of Maui Division of Motor Vehicles & Licensing at 110 Ala‘ihi St., Suite 101, Kahului, HI 96732.
For those whose current card is within six months of expiring, officials say they should renew their driver’s license or state ID instead of requesting a duplicate-reissue card.
Additional information about driver’s license and state ID services—including eligibility requirements and access to the online duplicate-reissue request form—is available on the county website.
